observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a small brown wood-finish tabletop/bar fridge sitting on top of another white fridge unit.
A round sticker reading 'Green Life' is visible on the top right corner of the fridge body (photo 1), but it is a generic eco-type sticker, not a manufacturer nameplate.
A keyhole/lock is visible on the front door (photo 0, photo 1).
Photo 2 shows the door open: interior is empty, appears clean, no visible frost or mold, one door shelf/bin with a bottle rail is visible.
Only one interior shelf is visible; no second shelf or crisper drawer is shown.
No power cord, plug, or electrical socket is visible in any photo.
No photo shows the unit powered on, a thermostat dial, frost formation, or a running compressor.
Background shows a warehouse/showroom with many other used fridges stacked, consistent with a bulk reseller setting.
Watermark 'FABULOUS FURNITURE' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' overlay all photos, indicating a listing photo set, not a direct buyer-taken photo.

claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows a clean, empty interior with no visible mold or heavy staining, but 'clean' as a condition claim beyond visual cleanliness (e.g. odor, hidden rust) cannot be confirmed remotely.
No photo can confirm a pickup arrangement; this is a logistics claim, not verifiable from images.

risks.risk: Cooling function unknown — no photo/video shows the fridge plugged in, running, or producing cold/frost.
risks.proof: A short video of the fridge plugged in, door closed, thermostat turned on, and compressor audibly running, ideally with a later frost/cold check.

risks.risk: Door seal/gasket condition unclear — seal looks slightly worn at edges in photo 2.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the full gasket perimeter showing no tears or gaps.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a worn/replaceable seal, factored into worst-case

risks.risk: Lock functionality and key availability unknown.
risks.proof: Photo or video of the key being used to lock/unlock the door.

risks.risk: Missing second shelf/crisper — only one shelf visible inside.
risks.proof: Full interior photo showing all original shelves/drawers present.

risks.risk: Body condition beyond the two visible sides (back, underside) not shown — compressor and coils condition unknown.
risks.proof: Photo of the rear panel showing compressor, coils, and power cord/plug.
risks.if_unproven: priced as worst-case rear condition (possible coil damage/no cord)

proof_requests: Video of the fridge plugged in and running, with visible cold air or frost after some minutes
Photo of the rear panel showing compressor, coils, and power cord
Close-up of the door gasket/seal all the way around
Photo/video confirming the lock and key work
Confirmation of all original shelves/drawers present
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a small tabletop/bar mini fridge by type, but with no evidence of it being powered on or cooling, so it must be priced at worst case as non-functional until a power/cooling proof is provided.
